title: Caramelized Plum Fry
description: A sweet and savory British-inspired dish made with caramelized plums in a stir-fry sauce.
instructions: Heat butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until caramelized, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add sliced plums and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together flour and red wine until smooth.
Add flour mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for 1-2 minutes, until sauce thickens.
Stir in stir-fry sauce and season with salt and pepper.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
